title: Locomotion Engine and Destination Movement
native_test_strategy: Build and run the Windows EXE through GitHub Actions after Step 27, then execute the cumulative native QA matrix.
known_limitations: Step 10 destinations remain within the active display work area; autonomous cross-display destination selection is not introduced.
Turning and start/stop choreography belong to Step 11.
The temporary tray movement controls are diagnostic scaffolding.
Cadence values require human video approval in the Windows EXE.
